tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers only H≤0.48, far short of the target horizon. The slow-horizon probe directly tests and calibrates the predicted adaptation reversal.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not identify the slow adaptation needed to forecast H=22.4.
Finer short-horizon measurements do not directly resolve long-horizon adaptation.
It does not address the temporal identifiability ambiguity.
